description_en: Queries the gateway and subnet mask information of an elastic IP address (EIP) by calling the DescribeEipGatewayInfo operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeEipGatewayInfo接口查询EIP的网关和掩码信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-eip-gateway-info --instance-id eni-bp1d66qjxb3qoin30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeEipGatewayInfo

parameters.description_en: The ID of the secondary elastic network interfaces (ENIs) to which the EIP that you want to query is attached. This parameter refers to the network interface controller (NIC) associated with the EIP.
parameters.description_zh: 要查询的EIP绑定的辅助弹性网卡的ID。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the secondary elastic network interfaces (ENIs) to which the EIP that you want to query is attached. This parameter refers to the network interface controller (NIC) associated with the EIP
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的EIP绑定的辅助弹性网卡的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.description_en: The region to which the EIP belongs. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query region IDs.
parameters.description_zh: 要查询的EIP所属的地域。您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
parameters.help_en: The region to which the EIP belongs. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的EIP所属的地域。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
